newsitem.title: UK: Wolseley up on talk of positive Capel stance.
newsitem.headline: Wolseley up on talk of positive Capel stance.

text.p: Shares in building materials suppliers Wolseley and Blue Circle Industries rose in a falling market on Monday amid talk HSBC James Capel was positive on the stocks following recent weakness, traders said.

Wolseley was up 12p at 457-1/2p with over half a million shares traded and Blue Circle gained 10p to 388-1/2p in volume exceeding one million shares. "James Capel are pushing both shares. They were big underperformers and due a bit of a rally. There's also a few short positions around," one marketmaker said, echoing comments from several market players.
Celia Duncan, analyst at James Capel, declined to comment.

Traders said Capel analysts were said to have visited the U.S. operations of both companies last week. But they said the visit did not result in any changes to stock recommendations or earnings forecasts.
